personalization.title: Personalization
personalization.subtitle: Accent colors, visual theme & Hana's identity
personalization.bgBlurHint: Lower opacity lets the background (particles) show through panels. Blur controls the glass effect on the sidebar and tabs.
personalization.syncPending: Saved in this browser; waiting for Hana.
personalization.avatarUpload: Change avatar (click to choose an image)
personalization.avatarError: Couldn't read this image — try a normal PNG/JPG.
personalization.identityRestoreHint: Restore returns name, subtitle and avatar to Hana's defaults (does not touch the color theme).
personalization.accessibilityDesc: Easier reading (dyslexia) and less distraction (ADHD). Applies instantly and is saved.
personalization.spacingHint: More space between letters and lines — helps with dyslexia.
personalization.reduceMotionHint: Disables animations and background particles. Less distraction and lighter on CPU.
personalization.focusModeHint: Hides decorative glows, showing only content.
personalization.highContrastHint: Pure black background, white text, no transparency. Best for low vision.
personalization.bigCursorHint: Bigger cursor that's easier to spot on screen.
personalization.lineFocusHint: Subtly highlights the line under the mouse. Helps maintain focus.
personalization.narrowTextHint: Limits text width for easier reading (ideal for dyslexia).
personalization.noItalicHint: Removes italic formatting, which is harder for dyslexic readers.
